fusions.name: Unpicked Seam
fusions.desc: Unpicks a seam in the target's armour, dealing 8 damage and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Gathering Stitch
fusions.desc: Draws a thread tight through every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 12 damage and stunning each for 1 second.

fusions.name: Mattress Suture
fusions.desc: Restores 16 health to you. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Emergency Patch
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 30%, you gain a shield worth 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
